title: nf-lenti pipeline parameters
description: Integrated pipeline for lentiviral-based single-cell lineage tracing

input_output_options.title: Input/Output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input_type.description: Type of raw input data (TENX_GBC entrypoint)
input_type.help_text: Selects how the single-cell GBC libraries are provided: separate TENX and GBC FASTQ libraries ('fastq'), GBC FASTQs plus external cell barcodes ('fastq,GBC'), a pre-aligned GBC bam plus external cell barcodes ('bam'), or a single set of FASTQs where TENX and GBC reads are mixed ('fastq,mixed'). Not used by the BULK_GBC entrypoint.

input_sheet.description: Path to the input sample sheet (CSV)
input_sheet.help_text: CSV sample sheet. Columns depend on the entrypoint and, for TENX_GBC, on input_type.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved
outdir.help_text: Absolute path to the output directory where all pipeline results will be stored.

alignment_options.title: Alignment options
alignment_options.description: Reference and cell-barcode resources used to align single-cell reads.

ref.description: Path to the STARsolo reference directory
ref.help_text: Directory containing the STAR genome index (with the lentiviral cassette contig) used by STARsolo.

tenx_whitelist.description: 10x Genomics cell barcode whitelist URL or path
tenx_whitelist.help_text: URL or path to the 10x Genomics cell barcode whitelist used by STARsolo (--soloCBwhitelist).

lentiviral_barcode_options.title: Lentiviral barcode options
lentiviral_barcode_options.description: Definition of the lentiviral cassette and of the integrated GBC location.

lenti_string.description: Name of the lentiviral cassette contig
lenti_string.help_text: Contig/sequence name of the lentiviral cassette in the reference; used to extract reads mapping to the cassette.

lenti_pattern.description: Lentiviral anchor sequence preceding the GBC
lenti_pattern.help_text: Anchor sequence used to identify GBC-containing reads (bulk search patterns and mixed-library splitting). Differs between the sc and bulk entrypoints.

lenti_start.description: 0-based offset of the GBC within the read (leading bases to skip)
lenti_start.help_text: 0-based start of the GBC. Used directly by the Python extractor and converted to 1-based inside awk (bulk).

lenti_bc_length.help_text: Number of bases of the integrated GBC to extract.

sequencing_data_preprocessing_options.title: Sequencing data preprocessing options
sequencing_data_preprocessing_options.description: Options controlling single-cell consensus read generation (fgbio).

CBs_chunk_size.description: Cell barcode chunk size for parallel processing

fgbio_UMI_consensus_edits.description: Maximum UMI edit distance for read grouping

fgbio_min_reads.description: Minimum reads for consensus sequence generation

fgbio_base_error_rate.description: Maximum fraction of discordant bases in a read group

fgbio_min_base_quality.description: Minimum base-calling quality of consensus bases

fgbio_min_alignment_quality.description: Minimum mapping quality of grouped reads

clone_calling_options.title: Clone calling options
clone_calling_options.description: Thresholds for CBC-GBC combination filtering and cell assignment.

umi_treshold.description: Minimum nUMIs to consider a CBC-GBC combination supported

p_treshold.description: Maximum Poisson p-value to consider a CBC-GBC combination supported

max_ratio_treshold.description: Minimum ratio of a GBC nUMIs to the most abundant GBC in a CBC

normalized_abundance_treshold.description: Minimum within-cell nUMIs fraction of a CBC-GBC combination

bulk_gbc_options.title: Bulk GBC options
bulk_gbc_options.description: Options controlling the bulk GBC entrypoint (BULK_GBC).

bulk_gbc_spikeins_table.help_text: If provided, spike-in GBCs listed here are removed from the bulk GBC counts.

bulk_gbc_graph_clustering_hamming_tresho.description: Maximum Hamming distance for GBC clustering

bulk_gbc_min_n_reads.description: Minimum reads for a corrected GBC to be retained

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
